description: This file defines the 'FieldConfig' class in Drupal, representing configuration for a field entity, including methods for creation, validation, dependency calculation, deletion, and loading by name.

classes.name: FieldConfig
classes.description: Represents a configurable field entity in Drupal, managing its creation, validation, dependencies, deletion, and retrieval.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs a new FieldConfig object, initializing properties based on provided values and ensuring required properties are set.

methods.name: postCreate
methods.description: Performs post-creation setup, including validation of storage and default label assignment.

methods.name: preSave
methods.description: Pre-save hook that validates and updates the field definition before saving.

methods.name: calculateDependencies
methods.description: Calculates configuration dependencies, notably the associated field storage configuration.

methods.name: preDelete
methods.description: Pre-deletion logic that marks fields for purging if they contain data.

methods.name: postDelete
methods.description: Post-deletion cleanup, including removal of unused field storage configurations.

methods.name: linkTemplates
methods.description: Generates link templates for editing and deleting field configurations.

methods.name: urlRouteParameters
methods.description: Provides URL route parameters, including bundle information.

methods.name: isDeleted
methods.description: Returns whether the field is marked as deleted.

methods.name: getFieldStorageDefinition
methods.description: Retrieves the field storage definition, loading it if necessary.

methods.name: isDisplayConfigurable
methods.description: Indicates if the field's display is configurable.

methods.name: getDisplayOptions
methods.description: Returns display options for the field, defaulting to hidden.

methods.name: isReadOnly
methods.description: Indicates if the field is read-only.

methods.name: isComputed
methods.description: Indicates if the field is computed.

methods.name: getUniqueIdentifier
methods.description: Returns a unique identifier for the field configuration.

methods.name: loadByName
methods.description: Static method to load a field configuration entity by entity type, bundle, and field name.
